import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    # If there are extra tokens, ignore beyond n
    values = tuple(float(x) for x in data[1:1+n])
    # Ensure immutability: values is a tuple, cannot be modified
    print("Configuration Values:")
    for v in values:
        print(f"{v:.5f}")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
